policy: Templates are deterministic practice plans aligned to the active official objective spine. They guide hands-on work but do not create assessment mastery or exam-readiness claims.

templates.title: Inspect and service a mobile device safely
templates.summary: Identify serviceable components, document the disassembly path, and practice a safe remove-and-reinstall procedure on available hardware.
equipment: Serviceable laptop or retired mobile device
safety_notes: Disconnect external power
Do not puncture, bend, or heat a battery
Stop if the device is swollen or physically damaged
steps: Record the model and current condition
Power down and apply ESD precautions
Identify and access one serviceable component
Remove and reinstall the component without forcing connectors
Reassemble and perform a functional check
success_checks: Device powers on normally
Serviced component is detected
No screws, clips, or cables remain unaccounted for
evidence_prompts: Capture the final detection or functional result

templates.title: Observe listening ports and identify services
templates.summary: Use local networking tools to inspect active TCP and UDP listeners and map selected ports to their purposes.
prerequisites: Access to a Windows, macOS, or Linux computer
safety_notes: Do not expose new services to the public internet
Do not scan systems you do not own or administer
steps: Select at least five observed or well-known ports
Identify the associated protocol and purpose
Close the session without changing firewall rules
success_checks: TCP and UDP listeners are distinguished
Five ports are accurately mapped
Output includes local address, port, and process where available
evidence_prompts: Describe one TCP and UDP difference you observed

templates.title: Document and validate a SOHO network
templates.summary: Create a private-network baseline, verify addressing and name resolution, and document secure configuration observations without disrupting service.
equipment: Computer connected to the private network
Router interface or read-only network information
safety_notes: Do not change the production router unless a rollback is prepared
Never record Wi-Worker1 passwords or administrator credentials
steps: Record the client IP, mask, gateway, and DNS servers
Identify the private address range and DHCP behavior
Document wireless security and guest-network observations
success_checks: Addressing and gateway are correctly identified
IP reachability and DNS are tested separately
Topology contains the router and at least two client roles
evidence_prompts: Record any configuration risk without including secrets

templates.title: Use a layered network troubleshooting toolkit
templates.summary: Diagnose a controlled connectivity problem with address, route, DNS, and path tools in a repeatable order.
prerequisites: A safe test network or VM
safety_notes: Use only systems and networks you are authorized to test
steps: Introduce or select one safe connectivity fault
Restore and verify the known-good state
success_checks: The fault is isolated to a layer
The original state is restored
The diagnostic sequence avoids unnecessary changes
evidence_prompts: State the symptom and root cause
Paste the minimum useful command evidence
Explain why each diagnostic step came next

templates.title: Inventory and validate system memory
templates.summary: Identify installed memory characteristics, compare them with platform limits, and run a non-destructive validation.
equipment: Built-in memory diagnostic or trusted test tool
safety_notes: Use ESD precautions if opening hardware
Do not remove memory while power is connected
steps: Record installed capacity and slot use
Compare installed configuration to platform support
Record the result and any limitations
success_checks: Capacity, generation, and slot population are documented
Platform compatibility is checked
Diagnostic completes without an unrecorded error
evidence_prompts: Record the diagnostic name and result

templates.title: Build and validate a virtual machine
templates.summary: Create an isolated VM, install a guest operating system, configure resources, and verify networking and snapshot recovery.
safety_notes: Use an isolated or NAT network for untrusted guests
Do not allocate resources that destabilize the host
steps: Create the VM with bounded CPU, memory, and storage
Install guest integration tools if appropriate
Make a reversible change and restore the snapshot
success_checks: Guest boots reliably
Resource allocation is documented
Network mode is identified
Snapshot restore returns the expected state
evidence_prompts: Capture guest network mode and address

templates.title: Build a Windows command-line support baseline
templates.summary: Use common Windows commands to collect system, disk, process, network, and policy information without changing the machine.
safety_notes: Run read-only commands
Redact usernames, hostnames, addresses, and product keys from saved evidence
steps: Inspect one relevant system policy or service
Save a short sanitized support baseline
success_checks: Baseline covers system, storage, process, and network state
Sensitive values are redacted
Commands are explained rather than merely pasted
evidence_prompts: Explain which command you would run first for one support scenario

templates.title: Practice the Linux client support toolkit
templates.summary: Navigate files, inspect permissions, manage processes, read logs, and collect network state on a Linux VM.
prerequisites: Linux VM or non-production Linux computer
safety_notes: Use a VM snapshot before permission experiments
Do not run destructive recursive commands
steps: Navigate and search a test directory
Change permissions on a disposable file
success_checks: File ownership and permission notation are explained
A process and service are inspected
Network address, route, and DNS state are captured
evidence_prompts: Describe where you found a useful log entry

templates.title: Apply and verify workstation hardening
templates.summary: Review a test workstation against a bounded hardening checklist, apply safe changes, and verify access still works.
prerequisites: Administrator access to a test VM
safety_notes: Use a test system
Create a rollback point before changing access or firewall settings
steps: Create a snapshot or restore point
Document and retain the rollback path
success_checks: Changes are tied to a stated risk
Normal access still works
Rollback is available
No credential value is stored in evidence
evidence_prompts: Explain one change you intentionally did not make

templates.title: Perform a backup and restore drill
templates.summary: Back up a controlled dataset, verify the backup, delete or alter a test copy, and prove restoration.
equipment: Built-in backup tool or file-copy utility
safety_notes: Use only disposable test data
Confirm source and destination before any deletion
Never treat an untested backup as successful
steps: Record source hashes or file counts
Back up to a separate location
Alter or remove only the disposable working copy
success_checks: Backup is stored separately
Restored content matches the source evidence
Recovery steps are documented
No real user data is placed at risk
evidence_prompts: Record the source and restored hashes or counts
Describe one failure mode this drill did not cover

templates.title: Write a safe support automation script
templates.summary: Create a small script that gathers support information, handles errors, and writes a sanitized report.
safety_notes: Default to read-only behavior
Never embed credentials or tokens
Quote paths and validate inputs
steps: Define the report fields and output path
Handle one expected command or file error
Run the script twice to verify repeatability
Review the output for unintended data
success_checks: Script exits predictably
Output is readable and timestamped
An error path is handled
No secret or credential is present
evidence_prompts: Link or paste the bounded script
Explain the error handling and safety choices
